description: Experience a bigger, brighter and more immersive home entertainment experience with the PIXPAQ Gold RAY Mastered. Featuring 3450 ANSI Lumens, the advanced Vision X Optical Engine delivers bright, sharp and detailed visuals for movies, sports, gaming and everyday entertainment. Powered by the MediaTek 9660 chipset and Android 13, the projector offers a smooth and responsive smart entertainment experience. Enjoy Native 1080p resolution with 4K support, including 4K playback on supported content from YouTube, Prime Video and Hotstar, for an enhanced big-screen viewing experience. The HDMI 2.1 interface provides high-speed connectivity for compatible gaming consoles, streaming devices, laptops and other home entertainment equipment. The included Bluetooth remote makes navigation convenient, while Bluetooth connectivity lets you pair compatible wireless audio devices. Designed for premium home cinema setups, the PIXPAQ Gold RAY Mastered combines powerful brightness, advanced optical performance, smart entertainment and versatile connectivity in one projector—bringing the cinematic experience closer to home.
